Code Animation Prompts: 341 Styles in One Click

Code Animation Prompts is the prompt library that turns a single sentence into a professional animated video. Instead of hunting through forums for specific effects, this collection gives you three hundred and forty-one distinct visual styles, ranging from retro pixel art to modern cinematic transitions, all ready to use. The real magic happens when you plug this into your coding assistant. You pick a look, drop in your text, and the system renders the actual motion for you, saving you hours of manual editing. It is essentially a cheat code for creators who want their content to look like it was made by a studio.

Open source: xiaoyecodes/code-animation-prompts

Follow for more open source project drops.

#CreativeCoding #MotionGraphics #TextToVideo #ClaudeCode #AICoding

transkript.t: Someone handed an AI a single line, a superhero comic book come to life.
What came back was a whole animated comic and every frame of it was written as code.
Normally a look like that means hours of keyframing by hand.
This free library is full of lines like that one, 341 looks, from ink painting to neon rain.
You pick one, tell your coding AI the story, and it plans the shots and builds the animation itself.
So your next intro starts with a sentence, not a blank timeline.
